summary: Requested a repeat execution rather than starting a new scenario I could not finish safely in the time left. The main finding rests on six receipts, and the one that first established the quorum-scale consequence — the window closing on the next leader heartbeat plus a single forged delivery carrying an up-to-date candidate to leadership at term 3 — is experiment acc6241dce584bc0a6817149dbe19f98-experiment (receipt 4ff9bf25cb164dd8bcf9d3be02aa1568). That experiment was itself a revised harness and has never been executed a second time in its fixed form, so repeating it from its retained inputs in a clean copy asks whether the observation is schedule-stable rather than a favourable interleaving of one run, which is what a repeat can establish and what a new scenario cannot. No new scenario and no record change beyond the receipt this produces; validation accepted the update with the repeat execution requested, and the remaining read-index follow-up (queue then leadership loss, then renewed leadership) stays registered as @readindex_leadership_loss for the next turn, when there is enough time to write and verify its harness before filing.
